# Grokipedia

> A comprehensive encyclopedia covering popular music history, classic songs and albums, and technical specifications for rifle cartridges and ammunition.

Grokipedia documents notable recordings from the 1970s-2000s across pop, rock, and alternative genres, alongside detailed ballistics and ammunition reference material. The site tracks chart performance, cultural impact, and technical specifications across both music and firearms domains.

## Key Topics

- Power ballads
- 1980s pop-rock
- Album reviews
- Song history
- Chart performance
- Rifle cartridges
- Ballistics specifications
- Varmint hunting
- Genesis
- Slipknot
- Aphex Twin
- Cutting Crew
- Billboard Hot 100
- Wildcat ammunition
- Hornady

## Classic Pop and Rock Songs

- [(They Long to Be) Close to You](https://grokipedia.com/page/(They_Long_to_Be)_Close_to_You): Bacharach-David pop ballad covered by The Carpenters, Grammy winner
- [(I Just) Died in Your Arms](https://grokipedia.com/page/(I_Just)_Died_in_Your_Arms): Cutting Crew's 1986 power ballad debut single by Nick Van Eede
- [(When You Gonna) Give It Up to Me](https://grokipedia.com/page/(When_You_Gonna)_Give_It_Up_to_Me): Sean Paul and Keyshia Cole's 2006 reggae fusion collaboration
- [(Si Si) Je Suis un Rock Star](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Si_Si)_Je_Suis_un_Rock_Star): Bill Wyman's 1981 solo single from Rolling Stones bassist

## Studio Albums and Releases

- [...And Then There Were Three...](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Then_There_Were_Three...): Genesis's 1978 album marking Phil Collins era transition
- [...I Care Because You Do](https://grokipedia.com/page/...I_Care_Because_You_Do): Aphex Twin's 1995 experimental electronic album on Warp Records
- [...The Dandy Warhols Come Down](https://grokipedia.com/page/...The_Dandy_Warhols_Come_Down): The Dandy Warhols' 1997 alternative rock album on Capitol Records

## Live Albums and Concert Recordings

- [(sic)nesses](https://grokipedia.com/page/(sic)nesses): Slipknot's 2009 live album from Download Festival performance
- [...Live in Chicago](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Live_in_Chicago): Panic! at the Disco's 2008 live concert film and album

## Rifle Cartridges and Ammunition

- [.277 Fury](https://grokipedia.com/page/.277_Fury): SIG Sauer's modern military rifle cartridge with ballistics data
- [.17 Mach IV](https://grokipedia.com/page/.17_Mach_IV): Wildcat rifle cartridge by Vern O'Brien with ballistics specifications
- [.17 HM2](https://grokipedia.com/page/.17_HM2): Hornady's 2004 rimfire cartridge with ballistics for varmint hunting
- [.22 Winchester Automatic](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_Winchester_Automatic): Obsolete 1903 Winchester rimfire cartridge with ballistics history
